item.title: 🇷🇺 Joint Statement on Further Strengthening the Russia-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership at a New Stage
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇻🇳 Joint Statement on Further Strengthening the Russia-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership at a New Stage (Moscow, September 9, 2026) The Leaders of Russia and Vietnam held an in-depth exchange of views on the current state and prospects of Russia-Vietnam relations and agreed on steps to further advance the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries . ✍️ Following the visit , the Russian Federation and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam declare the following : FOUNDATIONS, GOALS AND PRINCIPLES FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF RUSSIA-VIETNAM RELATIONS 1 . Relations between Russia and Vietnam, established in 1950, have always been characterised by fraternal friendship , deep trust and a readiness to assist each other . These qualities were particularly evident during the heroic Vietnamese people’s struggle for freedom and independence. In 2001, these relations were elevated to a strategic partnership , and in 2012 – to a comprehensive strategic partnership . 4 . Russia and Vietnam base their cooperation on mutual trust, long-term planning and effective engagement, in-depth strategic coordination, the fundamental principles of international law and the UN Charter , and equal and mutually beneficial cooperation. They seek to maintain close cooperation across all areas of bilateral relations and within multilateral frameworks . KEY AREAS OF BILATERAL COOPERATION • Politics and diplomacy • Defence and security • Trade and economic cooperation • Fuel and energy •

Joint Statement on Further Strengthening the Russia-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership at a New Stage
(Moscow, September 9, 2026)
The Leaders of Russia and Vietnam held
an in-depth exchange of views
on the current state and prospects of Russia-Vietnam relations and
agreed on steps to further advance the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries
.
✍️
Following
the visit
, the Russian Federation and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
declare the following
:
FOUNDATIONS, GOALS AND PRINCIPLES FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF RUSSIA-VIETNAM RELATIONS
1
. Relations between Russia and Vietnam, established in 1950, have always been characterised by
fraternal friendship
,
deep trust
and
a readiness to assist each other
. These qualities were particularly evident during the heroic Vietnamese people’s struggle for freedom and independence.
In 2001, these relations were elevated to
a strategic partnership
, and in 2012 – to
a comprehensive strategic partnership
.
4
. Russia and Vietnam base their cooperation on mutual trust, long-term planning and effective engagement, in-depth strategic coordination, the fundamental principles of international law and
the UN Charter
, and equal and mutually beneficial cooperation.
They seek to maintain close cooperation across all areas of bilateral relations and within multilateral frameworks
.
KEY AREAS OF BILATERAL COOPERATION
• Politics and diplomacy
• Defence and security
• Trade and economic cooperation
• Fuel and energy
• Transport
• Industry and agriculture
• Science and technology, education and professional training, healthcare
• Humanitarian cooperation
KEY AREAS OF INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION
34
. The Parties
consistently reaffirm
the outcomes of World War II
as enshrined in
the UN Charter
and
oppose attempts to distort and falsify the history of World War II
. They emphasise the importance of patriotic education, maintaining continuity between generations and preserving the memory of the struggle against Nazism, fascism and militarism.
The Parties also
attach
great importance
to
treating the shared history of the two countries with care and respect.
38
. The Parties stand ready
to help unite the international community’s efforts to counter traditional and emerging security challenges
, including terrorism, extremism and radicalisation, transnational crime, armed conflicts, the illicit production and trafficking of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, externally instigated coups d’état, climate change, natural disasters and epidemics.
44
. The Parties
reaffirm their intention to strengthen cooperation and coordination within
the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation
(
#APEC
)
Forum
as the key economic platform in the Asia-Pacific region
, operating on a depoliticised and non-discriminatory basis.
Russia
fully supports
Vietnam’s efforts to successfully host APEC in 2027
. Vietnam
welcomes and supports
Russia’s bid to host APEC in 2035. The Parties call on APEC members to give favourable consideration to bids on the basis of consensus to ensure the forum’s continued effective functioning.
48
. Russia highly appreciates
Vietnam’s balanced and objective stance on the Ukrainian crisis
and welcomes its readiness to join efforts to find ways to achieve a political and diplomatic settlement and restore regional stability, taking into account the legitimate security interests of all sovereign states.
Moscow and Hanoi are committed to international law and the principles of
the UN Charter
in their entirety and interrelationship.
They seek to help resolve the conflict around Ukraine by fully addressing its root causes in pursuit of a lasting peaceful solution
. The Parties express deep concern over civilian casualties and call on members of the international community
to refrain from supplying weapons to the conflict zone
.

👏
President of Russia Vladimir Putin took part in
the ceremony
presenting
the Leo Tolstoy International Peace Prize
to General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, President of Vietnam To Lam
(Moscow, September 9, 2026)
The award was presented to Comrade To Lam for his significant personal contribution to strengthening peace and cooperation among peoples. The ceremony was held in the St Andrew Hall of the Grand Kremlin Palace.
💬
President Putin
: This year, the award ceremony coincided with
Leo Tolstoy’s birthday
, which, in my view, is deeply symbolic.
It is universally recognized that Tolstoy’s creative legacy is part of the world’s cultural heritage
. It transcends time and ideological boundaries and has had – and continues to have – a profound influence on politicians, statesmen, public figures and generations of people across the world.
I know that Tolstoy’s literary and spiritual legacy is highly valued in Vietnam
. Vietnam’s first President,
Comrade
Ho Chi Minh
, wrote in an article published in the Soviet Literaturnaya Gazeta in 1960 that he had first encountered Tolstoy’s works in his youth. As he recalled, they made an indelible impression on him and inspired him to try his own hand at writing.
☝️
In Russia, we have always regarded with deep respect and admiration the resilience and courage of the Vietnamese people
, who endured
the severe trials of foreign oppression
, armed intervention and national division with dignity. The Vietnamese people know well the value of human life, peaceful coexistence, work and creation. This outlook on life and spirit is deeply consonant with the humanist philosophy of Leo Tolstoy.
Of course, we fully support
the unanimous decision of the multinational jury to award this year’s Leo Tolstoy Peace Prize to the Leader of Vietnam
, and through him
to the entire Vietnamese people.
Comrade To Lam is indeed
an authoritative and far-sighted statesman
,
a true patriot
who has chosen the path of dedicated service to his homeland and the defense of its national interests. As Head of State, he pursues
a balanced domestic and foreign policy
that contributes to strengthening an independent and sovereign Vietnam and to ensuring stability and security in Asia and throughout the world.
🤝
I also see this award as recognition of your substantial personal contribution to deepening friendship and mutual understanding between Russia and Vietnam
. As a principled and consistent supporter of advancing the Russia-Vietnam strategic partnership, you keep the development of direct political, economic and humanitarian ties between our countries under constant attention.

🎙
President of Russia Vladimir Putin's
statement to the media
following talks with General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, President of Vietnam To Lam
(Moscow, September 9, 2026)
Before addressing the media, the Leaders oversaw
an exchange of documents
signed during President To Lam’s
state visit to Russia
.
💬
Vladimir Putin
: Russia and Vietnam are
strategic partners
, and relations between our countries have consistently been built on
the principles of equality, mutual respect and consideration for each other’s interests.
Our peoples are bound by truly strong and long-standing ties of friendship, comradeship-in-arms, mutual assistance and support
. In its time, the Soviet Union did a great deal to help the young Vietnamese state withstand the struggle for freedom and independence, while also contributing to the development of its economy, social sector and infrastructure and to personnel training.
It is on this solid foundation that Russia-Vietnam cooperation
continues to develop successfully
and acquire new practical substance.
A number of major joint projects are being implemented
. The Intergovernmental Commission is operating effectively, while regular dialogue is maintained between the Foreign Ministries, security councils, parliaments, political parties and public organizations.
Today, Comrade To Lam, members of his delegation and I discussed
the state of bilateral cooperation
in detail, exchanged views on
current regional and international issues
and, of course,
outlined priorities
for further deepening the Russia-Vietnam partnership. These priorities are reflected in
the final Joint Statement
.
Considerable attention was devoted to economic issues
. We noted with satisfaction that trade
increased by 5.7%
in 2025. But, of course, as our dear friend and guest pointed out, this is not enough. In absolute terms, the overall volume still falls short of our potential.
📈
Nevertheless, the trend is positive: in the first half of 2026, trade grew by a further 13.8%.
This positive momentum is largely the result of
the free trade agreement concluded between Vietnam and the Eurasian Economic Union
.
The agreement has helped boost mutual investment and intensify technology exchanges.
☝️
Importantly, Russia and Vietnam are consistently shifting to national currencies in mutual settlements and building reliable channels of financial and banking cooperation
. In this way, we are protecting bilateral trade from the negative impact of the global political environment and volatility on world markets.
Today, Comrade To Lam and I opened by video link
a new modern laboratory at the Russia-Vietnam Tropical Research and Technology Centre in Hanoi
. The laboratory will focus on
disease prevention, the development of medicines and a number of other tasks
relevant to tropical climates.
Our discussion of current global and regional issues confirmed that the positions of Vietnam and Russia largely coincide or are very close
. Our countries firmly uphold the principles of the supremacy of international law, sovereignty and non-interference in internal affairs, and jointly support stable and sustainable development in the Asia-Pacific Region.
🤝
We discussed all these matters in detail with our Vietnamese colleagues,
stressing
the importance of continuing to coordinate our efforts at key multilateral platforms
, including within the
#RussiaASEAN
dialogue.

🎙
Statement by the delegation of the Russian Federation on behalf of
🇨🇳
🇮🇷
🇷🇺
People’s Republic of China, Islamic Republic of Iran, and Russian Federation on the agenda item 6 (d) of the session of the IAEA Board of Governors
"Implementation of the NPT safeguards agreement in Islamic Republic of Iran"
📍
Vienna, September 9, 2026
Full text of the Joint Statement
This Joint Statement is delivered on behalf of
People’s Republic of China, Islamic Republic of Iran, and Russian Federation
.
We underline that
the current agenda item is not relevant
. Pursuant to United Nations Security Council Resolution 2231 (2015), all of its provisions terminated on 18 October 2025. We maintain that the E3’s attempts to invoke the so-called “snapback” mechanism are null and void and lack legal effect. Accordingly, t
he request for the Director General to report on the implementation of those resolutions lacks a legal basis and risks politicizing
what should fundamentally remain a technical matter.
We recall Iran’s
long-standing commitment to nuclear non-proliferation as the State Party to the Treaty on the Non-proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT)
and also reaffirm the need for
the full and effective realization of the inalienable right of States to develop research, production, and use of nuclear energy for peaceful purposes
.
The repeated
attacks against Iran’s nuclear facilities under IAEA safeguards
, together with continuing threats of further aggression, which we strongly condemn, constitute an unprecedented situation in the history of the Agency and strike at the very foundations of the NPT.
Relevant resolution of the United Nations Security Council, as well as resolutions of the IAEA General Conference qualify
any attack or threat of attack against nuclear facilities as a violation of the principles of the United Nations Charter, international law and the Statute of the Agency
.
The United States’ attacks against Iran continue, with further attacks in recent days
. Accordingly, the prevailing security conditions have effectively rendered the normal implementation of the IAEA safeguards in Iran impossible. This reality has also been acknowledged in the recent reports of the Director General to the Board of Governors.
<...>
Regarding the draft resolution proposed by the United States, Germany, France and the United Kingdom, we wish to underscore that, irrespective of its procedural and substantive deficiencies,
the draft resolution fails even to make explicit reference to the attacks, which constitute the root cause and principal factor underlying the current situation
. The finding of Iran’s alleged non-compliance with its safeguards obligations in June 2025 was politically motivated and far-fetched. It also paved the way for attacks against Iran’s nuclear facilities under IAEA safeguards, becoming the root cause of the subsequent difficulties in safeguards implementation in Iran. This is explicitly recognized in the Director General’s reports. The new draft resolution is yet another attempt by its co-authors to exert additional pressure on Iran and undermine cooperation between Iran and the Agency. In the same vein,
the alleged “referral” to the UN Security Council lacks a legal basis, intends to aggravate the situation, and is inconsistent with the co-authors’ stated commitment to diplomacy
. We therefore encourage all responsible Member States to carefully consider its implications and refrain from supporting the draft resolution.
We are of the firm view that a
sustainable resolution of the current situation
can only be achieved through
the immediate and permanent termination of all attacks, the elimination of threats of further aggression, and the recognition that all legitimate questions regarding Iran’s nuclear programme must be addressed exclusively through dialogue and diplomacy
, as the only viable path forward.

item.title: ✉️ Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov sent a congratulatory message to Foreign Minister of the DPRK Choe Son-hui
item.description: ✉️ Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov sent a congratulatory message to Foreign Minister of the DPRK Choe Son-hui (September 9, 2026) ✍️ Please accept my heartfelt congratulations on the 78th anniversary of the founding of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea . Your country is steadily advancing along the path of strengthening its sovereignty and improving the well-being of its people. I am sincerely pleased with the successes of our Korean friends. I note with satisfaction the strong momentum in the development of multifaceted and comprehensive Russia-DPRK cooperation and strategic partnership , fully in line with the agreements reached in June 2024 by President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Putin and President of the State Affairs of the DPRK Kim Jong-un . I am confident that the productive joint work of the Foreign Ministries of Russia and the DPRK will contribute to fulfilling the tasks set by our Leaders . Their implementation fully serves the interests of the peoples of our two countries and contributes to our common goals of building a just #MultipolarWorld and maintaining peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula and in Northeast Asia. 🤝 I wish you and all employees of the DPRK Foreign Ministry good health and outstanding success in your responsible work. SERGEY LAVROV 🇷🇺 🇰🇵 #RussiaDPRK

item.title: ⚡️ #KievRegimeCrimes Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
item.description: #KievRegimeCrimes ⚡️ Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik : 💬 From August 31 to September 6 , аgainst the backdrop of substantial retaliatory strikes by the Russian Armed Forces against military and dual-use facilities on Ukrainian territory, as well as short-term, mutually observed targeted restrictions on strikes while US representatives visiting Russia and Ukraine for consultations on a peaceful settlement were present there, the number of terrorist attacks by Ukrainian armed groups and civilian casualties somewhat declined compared with the previous week . At the same time, the figures remained very high : more than 300 civilians were affected, with 46 people killed as a result of criminal Ukrainian attacks on civilian facilities in Russia. The highest numbers of civilian casualties from Ukrainian attacks were recorded in the Belgorod Region, DPR and LPR, and the Zaporozhye and Kherson regions. Ukrainian strike drones remained the main cause of civilian deaths and injuries. A total of 309 civilians, or 99% of all those affected , were killed or injured in Ukrainian UAV strikes. From August 31 to September 6 , shelling by Ukrainian Nazis affected 312 civilians: 266 people were injured, including 13 children. A total of 46 people were killed, including 2 children. Over the past seven days , Ukrainian militants fired at least 6,650 munitions at civilian facilities on Russian territory.

item.description: 🇷🇺 Russia's Federal Agency for the CIS, Compatriots Living Abroad, and International Humanitarian Cooperation ( #Rossotrudnichestvo ): On September 9, employees of the Russian House in Berlin returned to Russia with their families . Following the German authorities’ decision to shut down the center, they were issued a harsh ultimatum – just seven days to leave the country. 💬 The first group was welcomed by Rossotrudnichestvo Head Igor Chaika : “Our people are our top priority right now. We do not abandon our colleagues. We will help them find new positions and do everything we can to ensure that their experience and expertise remain in demand”. Rossotrudnichestvo is already working out further employment options for each staff member – at its headquarters, other Russian Houses and new partner venues. Their future employment is under the personal supervision of the agency’s head. Employees returning from Berlin were also welcomed with flowers and gifts in Nizhny Novgorod . Another group is traveling by car across Europe to bring back at least some of the Russian House’s valuable property. ☝️ The Russian House operated in Berlin for more than 40 years . Over the past 15 years alone, it welcomed more than 3 million visitors . The House may have been closed. 👉 But people, ties and decades of shared history cannot be erased by a single decision.
